mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lexical_evidence_generations (source_id, source_version, index_version) VALUES (#{key.sourceId}, #{key.sourceVersion}, #{key.indexVersion}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, source_version, index_version) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO lexical_evidence_chunks (source_id, source_version, index_version, ordinal, evidence_id, location_type, start_ms, end_ms, body, paragraph, page, terms) VALUES
(#{key.sourceId}, #{key.sourceVersion}, #{key.indexVersion}, #{chunk.ordinal}, #{chunk.evidence.evidenceId}, #{chunk.evidence.locationType}, #{chunk.evidence.startMs,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{chunk.evidence.endMs,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{chunk.evidence.text}, #{chunk.evidence.paragraph,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{chunk.evidence.page,jdbcType=INTEGER}, string_to_array(#{chunk.terms}, ' '))
mapper.select: SELECT evidence_id, source_id::text AS source_id, source_version, location_type, start_ms, end_ms, body, paragraph, page FROM lexical_evidence_chunks c CROSS JOIN (SELECT string_to_array(#{terms}, ' ') AS terms) q WHERE AND c.terms && q.terms ORDER BY (SELECT count(*) FROM unnest(q.terms) AS term WHERE term = ANY(c.terms)) DESC, ordinal LIMIT #{limit}
